title: Max's First Day at McKinley
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for the McKinley Bulldogs.

pages: Today is a big day. Max is going to school!
Max has a new backpack. It is blue, like McKinley.
Max lines up with the other kids. Max is a little scared.
The teacher smiles. "Welcome to kindergarten, Max!"
Max finds a cubby with a name on it. M-A-X!
A girl sits next to Max. Her name is Lupe.
"I like your ears," says Lupe. "I like your shoes," says Max.
At lunch, the class walks to the MPR. It is so big!
Max opens the milk. Oops! The milk spills.
Lupe helps Max wipe it up. "That is what friends do," she says.
At home, Max says, "School is great. I can not wait for tomorrow!"

quiz.ev: At lunch, the class walks to the MPR.

quiz.q: How did Max feel at the end of the day?
quiz.ev: School is great. I can not wait for tomorrow!
